name: Lowes Warehouse | Mt. Pocono, PA
hero_alt: Finished, striped parking lot at Lowes Warehouse, Mt. Pocono
paragraphs: This large-scale distribution warehouse in Mt. Pocono required extensive site work, and our crew handled the paving, curbing, and concrete work across the property's expansive parking and loading areas.

Our team poured and finished miles of concrete curbing, placed and compacted asphalt across the lot, and completed final striping — delivering a fully finished, functional site for a major distribution facility.
